summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 5, 2026, announcing the appointment of Garzon Duenas as General Manager and Commissioning Leader, effective immediately. The hire supports the company's Ontario cobalt sulfate refinery transition from construction to commissioning, with select commissioning activities targeted for Q4 2026, mechanical completion Q2 2027, ramp-up Q3 2027, and commercial production Q4 2027. This is a routine operational management appointment, not a forced CEO/CFO/board departure. No special-situation transaction, terms, or deal mechanics are present.
